# anomaly_team (Data Source)

Looks up a single nxs-anomaly team by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing object. Alternatively, supply id instead of name.
data "anomaly_team" "example" {
  name = "Operations"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID to look up. Supply either id or the name/username lookup attribute.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `member_ids` (List of String)
- `updated_at` (String)
